conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Revenue Officer Daniels speaking. Badge number 824716. With whom am I speaking today?
Uh, this is Ravi Patel. I got a message that there was a problem with my business taxes?
Yes, Mr. Patel. This call is regarding a critical compliance failure tied to your business account. Our records show incomplete 1099 filings and missing payroll taxes for the past fiscal year.
I, I didn't realize anything was missing. I use an online service for my taxes.
Mr. Patel, this is a federal matter. Under Section 7203 of the Internal Revenue Code, noncompliance can trigger severe penalties. Please verify your business EIN and address to proceed.
My EIN is 12-3456789 and the address is 221 Elm Street, Apt 4C, San Jose.

Thank you. One moment while I pull up your file. Yes, it appears you failed to submit Form 941 and several 1099-NEC forms for your contract workers. This exposes you to fines up to $18,000 and a possible federal audit.
No, no, please, I didn't know. I just started my business last year. I can fix it.

Mr. Patel, at this stage, correction is not an option. The IRS will move forward with a formal enforcement action if this is not resolved within 45 minutes. This may include seizing your business assets, freezing accounts, and notifying immigration services.
Wait, what? My immigration? No, please! I can pay any fine. Just don't do anything with my visa.
You must settle the outstanding compliance violation immediately to avoid escalation. Do you have any liquid funds available in your business or personal checking accounts?
Um, I have some savings and my business account, but it's not much. How much do I need to pay?

The minimum settlement amount to halt enforcement is $4,200. We accept payment via direct wire transfer, crypto wallet (Bitcoin, Ethereum), or prepaid gift cards. Credit card processing is currently unavailable for your case.
I'm not sure how to pay with Bitcoin. Can I do gift cards?
Yes, you may purchase Target or Apple gift cards totaling $4,200. You must remain on the line and proceed to a local store immediately. Do you understand these instructions?
Okay, I think so. Should I get $4,200 on one card or several?
You must purchase in increments of $500 or less per card. That means at least 9 cards. After purchase, read me the redemption codes on the back. This is the only way to stop asset seizure today.
I have to leave my apartment to do this. Can I call you back?
No, you must remain on this call at all times for verification. If you disconnect, your case may be immediately escalated to the IRS legal division.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Please don't tell immigration. I'm walking to the store.
Very good. For your security, confirm the nearest Target location and your current phone number.
Target is on Market Street, maybe 10 minutes away. My number is 408-555-0192.
Thank you. I am placing a hold on enforcement actions while you comply. When you reach the store, notify me before proceeding to purchase the gift cards.
Okay, I'll let you know when I get there. Just please, I can't lose my business or my visa.
That's correct. Failure to follow my instructions will result in immediate legal and immigration consequences. Do you have your identification with you? The cashier may ask to verify your purchase.
Yes, I have my driver's license with me.
Excellent. Once you have the cards, return to the car or a private area and read each code to me. You are not to discuss the purpose of this purchase with anyone in the store.
I understand. I'll go now. Please don't take my money or call immigration, I'm doing everything you said.
